name: Mercenary Flurry of Arrows
notes: HoH1 Mercenary version of Flurry of Arrows (players/ranger/mercenary/flurry_of_arrows_merc.sval, 15 skill points in the Mercenary skill shop). Against HoH1 level 6 (in brackets): 48 fixed arrows (64 Bow Shot arrows). Its own mana 40 (35), cooldown 0.75 s. Mercenaries bought one fixed version of a class's skill once that class reached level 20 in town; its 'Primary Attack' wording let the class passives work with any weapon.
summary: Flurry of Arrows fires 48 arrows of its own (20 physical, pierce 7) instead of copies of your Bow Shot, so it works with any primary attack.
